scene:step_list.object_description: a numbered step list with a title and detail line on each step card

query:nth_step_title.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible step title requested by the question
query:nth_step_title.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to one [x0, y0, x1, y1] box around the requested step title

query:nth_step_detail.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible step detail text requested by the question
query:nth_step_detail.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to one [x0, y0, x1, y1] box around the requested step detail text

query:step_after_named_step.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible title of the step immediately after the named source step
query:step_after_named_step.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to one [x0, y0, x1, y1] box around the answer step title

query:step_title_for_detail.answer_hint: set "answer" to the exact visible title of the step containing the named detail text
query:step_title_for_detail.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to one [x0, y0, x1, y1] box around the answer step title

query:step_number_for_detail.answer_hint: set "answer" to the step number as visible text
query:step_number_for_detail.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to one [x0, y0, x1, y1] box around the answer step number badge
